events.title: Babytime
events.description: Join us on Monday mornings in Hunneman Hall for a baby lapsit program. Come prepared to sit on the floor with your baby in your lap and sing and play together! The second half of the program will be an open socialization and play time. This program is for babies who aren't walking yet. No ticket or registration required.

events.title: LEGO Lovers
events.description: Drop in and join us for an opportunity to free-build or complete building challenges with Legos and Duplo! This program is intended for kids ages 5-9, along with siblings and caregivers.

events.title: Craft Club
events.description: Calling all artists! Join us on Mondays from 3:30 – 4:30 PM in the Rabbit Hole for a weekly craft program. We’ll have different materials each week, and kids will have access to a variety of art supplies and will be encouraged to use their imagination in order to make anything they like. This is a drop-in program for kids ages 5 to 9.
